text:
sara-support: :rotating_light: Seeing a sudden 504 spike from hosted inference since the last rollout — error rate from ~12% -> ~20% on slice-b. Multiple customer tickets reporting timeouts and failed calls. Root request ts 4701234567.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished commit abcdef12 -> prod at 2026-03-17T09:07Z. Canary weight=5% target=sliced-release traffic-slice-b.

liam-oncall: Pulling metrics now. Traces show gateway hitting model-backend RPCs that time out ~10s, many connection resets.

maya-eng: Quick hypothesis: the sliced_release flag was mis-scoped — intended to be route-tag gated but looks global. If the flag is global, router might forward unexpectedly. Can someone dump flag state?

jun-ops: Running quick check: `kubectl get configmap rollout-flags -o yaml | grep -A2 sliced_release` -> shows `sliced_release: "true"` and no qualifier key. That looks wrong (should be `sliced_release.route=traffic-slice-b`).

sara-support: Repro snippet from a customer: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?route=traffic-slice-b` -> consistently returns 504 after ~10s.

liam-oncall: Confirmed: router logs show 100% of slice-b traffic routed to the canary instance group because qualifier absent. Backend canary saturating and hitting slow paths, causing gateway timeouts.

maya-eng: Action plan: 1) rollback canary commit abcdef12 from production canary pool, 2) patch rollout-flags to set scoped qualifier or reset to false, 3) monitor SLOs and notify CS.

jun-ops: Initiating rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for commit abcdef12 at 4701234600. Canary traffic drained.

jun-ops: Patching flag to safe state: `kubectl patch configmap rollout-flags -p '{"data":{"sliced_release":"false"}}'` -> applied.

liam-oncall: Metrics update: 504 rate on slice-b dropping back toward baseline within 2–4 minutes. Latency p95 also improving. Watching for any residual errors.

alex-product: Notifying CS and preparing a short customer-facing note: explain rollback, root cause (flag mis-scope), and ETA for postmortem. Also flagging potential billing mis-attribution reports to audit.

sara-support: I will open/update support tickets with the rollback timeline, attach logs, and provide the customer-facing note. Will escalate any billing anomalies separately. :thumbsup:

liam-oncall: Stabilized for now. Recommendation: hold any further staged rollouts until we add an automated preflight that validates flag scoping and route qualifiers.

maya-eng: Agreed — adding CI check for config qualifiers and a quick router-simulation in the pipeline. I'll start a PR.

sara-support: Closing this incident thread after we confirm CS messages sent and billing audit kicked off. Good job team. :white_check_mark:
